analyst_view.overall: Early view: Las Palmas are on their third coach of the season, Albert Sánchez, who arrived from Dunkerque at the end of October after Rubén de la Barrera left and an interim spell; results have picked up (last five LLWWW). Celta Fortuna (16th) had lost four straight away from Balaídos and arrived at Burgos with five injured players. The three yellow-card bans in the brief will be long served by mid-December.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. Las Palmas have conceded 21 and Celta Fortuna 25, so both defences leak, which fits a high total; I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. Celta Fortuna tend to drop deep once ahead or under pressure, and Burgos forced 10 corners to 1 against them, so I lean higher.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.6 cards. Nothing in the news points either way and the referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.8 shots. Burgos had 19 shots to 6 against Celta Fortuna in November and Las Palmas should have most of the ball at home, so I lean a little higher.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. Las Palmas's finishing under a new coach is still an open question, so I stay with the number.
